examples.name: Create a transaction with an idempotency key
examples.description: Creates a transaction and returns its ID. Reuse the same key only to retry this same request.
examples.query:
mutation CreateTransaction(
  $merchant_uid: String!
  $amount: Int!
  $idempotency_key: String
  $payment_method_id: String
  $fee_mode: FeeMode
) {
  createTransaction(
    merchant_uid: $merchant_uid
    amount: $amount
    idempotency_key: $idempotency_key
    payment_method_id: $payment_method_id
    fee_mode: $fee_mode
  ) {
    transaction_id
    merchant_uid
    gross_amount
    net_amount
    currency
    status
    fee_mode
    fees
    transaction_type
    transaction_date
  }
}
